name: redliner
description: A layered manuscript-editing tool for fiction, design docs, and other long-form writing, distributed as a single Claude Code / Cowork plugin.

plugins.name: redliner
plugins.description: Layered manuscript-editing pipeline (fiction, design docs, and other long-form domains): developmental and line editing, plus a cross-cutting continuity/canon-consistency layer, running as Claude Code subagents. For the CLI (bin/-on-PATH); Cowork rejects this variant's plugin content, use redliner-cowork there instead.

plugins.name: redliner-cowork
plugins.description: The same redliner pipeline, packaged for Cowork and other claude.ai-hosted surfaces that don't allow a top-level bin/ directory: identical operations, exposed via an MCP server instead.
